prelims.subject: Current Affairs
prelims.important_chapters: Government Schemes, International Summits, Science Discoveries, Awards & Honours, Sports Events, Defence Exercises, Bills & Acts, Appointments
prelims.important_topics: Budget highlights, Union/State schemes, Climate summits (COP), G20/BRICS/SCO, New species discovered, Space missions (ISRO/NASA), Trade agreements, Constitutional amendments
prelims.revision_strategy: Daily: The Hindu/Indian Express (30 min). Weekly: compile notes by GS paper. Monthly: revision of all compiled notes. Use PIB, PRS, Yojana, Kurukshetra.

prelims.subject: Polity & Constitution
prelims.important_chapters: Fundamental Rights & Duties, DPSP, Parliament, President & Governor, Supreme Court & High Courts, Constitutional Bodies, Amendment Procedure, Federalism, Local Governance, Election Commission
prelims.important_topics: Articles 12-35 (Rights), 36-51 (DPSP), Amendment process, Anti-defection law, RTI Act, Panchayati Raj, CAG, Finance Commission, UPSC, Tribunals, Emergency provisions
prelims.revision_strategy: Master Laxmikanth chapter-wise. Practice article-based MCQs. Focus on recent SC judgments. Create comparison charts (President vs Governor, LS vs RS).

prelims.subject: Modern History
prelims.important_chapters: British Expansion, Revolt of 1857, Social Reform Movements, Indian National Congress, Gandhian Era, Revolutionary Movements, Post-Independence India
prelims.important_topics: Governor Generals & policies, Land revenue systems, Swadeshi movement, Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience, Quit India, Tribal revolts, Press acts, Partition, Constitution making
prelims.revision_strategy: Spectrum (Rajiv Ahir) as base. Create timeline charts. Link freedom fighters to movements. Practice statement-based PYQs. NCERT 8, 11, 12.

prelims.subject: Ancient History
prelims.important_chapters: Indus Valley Civilization, Vedic Period, Buddhism & Jainism, Mauryan Empire, Gupta Empire, Sangam Age, Temple Architecture
prelims.important_topics: Harappan sites & features, Vedic literature (Shruti/Smriti), Ashoka's edicts, Gupta art & science, Rock-cut architecture, Sangam literature, Ancient trade routes
prelims.revision_strategy: NCERT 6, 11 (Ancient India). Tamil Nadu Board textbooks. Focus on archaeological sites, art & architecture. Map-mark important sites.

prelims.subject: Medieval History
prelims.important_chapters: Delhi Sultanate, Vijayanagara & Bahmani, Mughal Empire, Bhakti & Sufi Movements, Maratha Empire, Regional Kingdoms
prelims.important_topics: Sultanate administration, Mughal architecture, Din-i-Ilahi, Bhakti saints (Kabir, Nanak, Mirabai), Shivaji's administration, Land revenue systems (Iqta, Mansabdari, Ryotwari)
prelims.revision_strategy: Satish Chandra (Medieval India). Focus on administration systems, cultural developments. Compare dynasties. Link architecture to periods. NCERT 7, 11.

prelims.subject: Art & Culture
prelims.important_chapters: Indian Architecture (Temple, Indo-Islamic, Colonial), Painting Schools, Classical & Folk Dances, Music, Literature, UNESCO World Heritage Sites, Handicrafts & Textiles
prelims.important_topics: Temple styles (Nagara, Dravida, Vesara), Mughal miniatures, Rajput paintings, Bharatanatyam/Kathak/Odissi, GI-tagged products, Intangible Cultural Heritage, Rock-cut caves
prelims.revision_strategy: Nitin Singhania (Art & Culture). Visual learning — see images of monuments. Create comparison tables. Map UNESCO sites. Practice identification-based questions.

prelims.subject: Geography
prelims.important_chapters: Geomorphology, Climatology, Oceanography, Indian Physical Geography, Indian Climate & Monsoon, Soil & Vegetation, Resources & Industries, Population & Urbanization
prelims.important_topics: Plate tectonics, Monsoon mechanism, El Niño/La Niña, River systems, Soil types, Agro-climatic zones, Mineral distribution, Census data, Smart Cities, Migration patterns
prelims.revision_strategy: NCERT 6-12 Geography. Majid Husain for Indian Geography. Always study with atlas. Draw maps from memory. Practice map-based questions weekly.

prelims.subject: Economics
prelims.important_chapters: National Income, Money & Banking, Fiscal Policy, Monetary Policy, Inflation, External Sector, Agriculture, Industry, Infrastructure, Government Budgeting
prelims.important_topics: GDP/GNP concepts, RBI tools (Repo, CRR, SLR), Types of inflation, FDI vs FPI, WTO agreements, GST, FRBM Act, Disinvestment, PPP model, Financial inclusion schemes
prelims.revision_strategy: Ramesh Singh as base. NCERT 11-12. Read Economic Survey highlights. Track Budget data. Practice concept-based MCQs. Link theory to current data.

prelims.subject: Environment & Ecology
prelims.important_chapters: Ecosystems, Biodiversity, Pollution, Climate Change, Conservation (In-situ & Ex-situ), Environmental Laws, Protected Areas, International Agreements
prelims.important_topics: Ramsar wetlands, Biosphere reserves, Tiger reserves, IUCN Red List categories, COP agreements, Paris Agreement, Ozone layer, Renewable energy, EIA, Wildlife Protection Act 1972
prelims.revision_strategy: Shankar IAS Environment. NCERT Biology chapters. Map all National Parks & Sanctuaries. Create species-habitat flashcards. Track environmental news weekly.

prelims.subject: Indian Society
prelims.important_chapters: Diversity of India, Caste System, Communalism, Regionalism, Secularism, Women's Issues, Population & Urbanization, Globalization Effects
prelims.important_topics: Tribal issues, Gender inequality, Demographic dividend, Social empowerment schemes, Urbanization challenges, Role of NGOs, Poverty & inequality, Migration patterns
prelims.revision_strategy: NCERT Sociology 11-12. Link social issues to government schemes. Use data from Census, NFHS, HDI reports. Practice answer writing with case studies.

prelims.subject: Governance
prelims.important_chapters: Government Policies & Schemes, E-governance, Transparency & Accountability, Role of Civil Services, Welfare Schemes, Statutory & Regulatory Bodies
prelims.important_topics: RTI Act, Citizen's Charter, Social Audit, DBT, Aadhaar, Digital India, MGNREGA, PMJDY, Ayushman Bharat, NEP 2020, PM-KISAN, Smart Cities Mission
prelims.revision_strategy: Track all major government schemes with launch year, ministry, and beneficiaries. Create comparison tables. Practice Mains-style answers on scheme analysis.

prelims.subject: International Relations
prelims.important_chapters: India's Foreign Policy, India & Neighbours, India & Major Powers, International Organizations, Regional Groupings, Global Issues
prelims.important_topics: India-China relations, India-Pakistan, India-US strategic partnership, Quad, BRICS, SCO, ASEAN, UN reforms, WTO disputes, Nuclear doctrine, Maritime security, Indo-Pacific
prelims.revision_strategy: Rajesh Rajagopalan (IR textbook). Track MEA statements. Map India's bilateral relations. Focus on recent treaties & agreements. Practice answer writing on IR themes.

prelims.subject: Science & Technology
prelims.important_chapters: Space Technology, Defence Technology, Biotechnology, Nanotechnology, IT & Cyber Security, Nuclear Technology, Health & Disease
prelims.important_topics: ISRO missions (Chandrayaan, Gaganyaan, Aditya-L1), DRDO projects, AI & Machine Learning, 5G/6G, Blockchain, Gene editing (CRISPR), Quantum computing, Cyber threats
prelims.revision_strategy: Science Reporter magazine. Track ISRO/DRDO news. Understand basic concepts (not deep science). Create technology-application mapping. Practice application-based MCQs.

prelims.subject: Ethics
prelims.important_chapters: Ethical Thinkers (Indian & Western), Attitude, Aptitude, Emotional Intelligence, Public Service Values, Probity in Governance, Case Studies
prelims.important_topics: Aristotle, Kant, Gandhi, Ambedkar, Kautilya ethics, Foundational values (Integrity, Empathy, Tolerance), Ethical dilemmas, Conflict of interest, Corporate governance, RTI & transparency
prelims.revision_strategy: Lexicon Ethics (Chronicle). Practice 15+ case studies weekly. Build vocabulary of ethical concepts. Write 200-word answers daily. Link thinkers to real situations.

prelims.subject: Internal Security
prelims.important_chapters: Terrorism, Naxalism, Border Security, Cyber Security, Money Laundering, Organized Crime, Role of Media & Social Media, Defence Forces
prelims.important_topics: Left Wing Extremism, J&K situation, NE insurgency, UAPA Act, NIA, AFSPA, Coastal security, Drone threats, Radicalization, FATF, Hawala, Dark web
prelims.revision_strategy: Ashok Kumar (Internal Security). Track MHA reports. Understand institutional framework (NIA, NSA, RAW, IB). Practice answer writing on security-development balance.

prelims.subject: Sociology (Optional)
prelims.important_chapters: Sociological Thinkers, Research Methods, Stratification, Religion & Society, Social Movements, Indian Society Structure, Caste & Class, Tribal Communities, Challenges of Social Transformation
prelims.important_topics: Marx, Weber, Durkheim, Merton, Parsons, Indian thinkers (M.N. Srinivas, A.R. Desai, Andre Beteille), Sanskritization, Dominant caste, Agrarian class structure, Women's movement, Dalit movement
prelims.revision_strategy: Haralambos (Sociology). IGNOU notes for Indian Society. Practice 20-mark answers weekly. Use diagrams/flowcharts. Link thinkers to Indian examples. Cover Paper 1 & 2 equally.

mains.subject: GS1: History, Geography, Society
mains.important_chapters: Ancient-Medieval-Modern History linkages, World History (French/Industrial Revolution), Indian Geography in depth, Indian Society & Diversity, Women & Urbanization
mains.important_topics: Freedom struggle phases, Post-independence consolidation, World Wars impact, Colonialism, Globalization effects, Social empowerment, Salient features of Indian society, Population issues
mains.revision_strategy: Analytical approach — don't just describe, analyze causes & effects. Practice 250-word answers. Use maps in Geography answers. Include data & examples. Write 3 answers/day from GS1.

mains.subject: GS2: Polity, Governance, IR
mains.important_chapters: Constitutional provisions, Parliament & State Legislatures, Executive & Judiciary, Federal structure, Govt policies for vulnerable sections, International relations, India & neighbours
mains.important_topics: Separation of powers, Judicial activism, Centre-State relations, Statutory bodies, NGOs-SHGs, Health-Education governance, India's foreign policy evolution, Bilateral & multilateral relations
mains.revision_strategy: Current + static integration is key. Every Polity answer must reference recent developments. Practice writing Introduction-Body-Conclusion format. Use SC judgments as examples.

mains.subject: GS3: Economy, Environment, Security
mains.important_chapters: Indian Economy development, Agriculture, Food security, Industrial policy, Infrastructure, Environment conservation, Disaster management, Internal security challenges
mains.important_topics: Inclusive growth, Land reforms, Food processing, E-technology, Environmental pollution, Conservation strategies, Linkages of organized crime with terrorism, Border management, Cyber security
mains.revision_strategy: Data-heavy paper — memorize key statistics. Economic Survey is must-read. Environment answers need diagrams. Security answers need balanced view. Practice 3 answers/day.

mains.subject: GS4: Ethics & Integrity
mains.important_chapters: Ethics fundamentals, Attitude & Aptitude, Emotional Intelligence, Contributions of moral thinkers, Public service values, Probity in governance, Case studies (125 marks)
mains.important_topics: Ethical dilemmas in governance, Conflict of interest, Corporate governance ethics, Compassion & empathy in public service, Ethical concerns in international relations, Information sharing & transparency
mains.revision_strategy: Case studies = 125 marks (half the paper). Practice 2 case studies daily. Build ethical vocabulary. Quote thinkers naturally. Maintain word limit strictly. Focus on actionable solutions.

mains.subject: Essay
mains.important_chapters: Philosophical & Abstract topics, Social issues, Political themes, Economic topics, Science & Environment, International issues
mains.important_topics: Democracy themes, Technology impact, India's role in world, Gender equality, Environmental ethics, Education reforms, Rural-urban divide, Cultural preservation
mains.revision_strategy: Write 1 full essay/week (1000-1200 words). Structure: Intro → Multidimensional body (social, economic, political, ethical angles) → Conclusion. Use quotes, data, examples. Read topper essays.

mains.subject: Sociology (Optional)
mains.important_chapters: Paper 1: Sociology as Science, Thinkers, Stratification, Methods, Work & Economy, Politics & Society, Religion | Paper 2: Indian Society, Caste, Tribal, Social Movements, Social Changes
mains.important_topics: Classical thinkers (Marx, Weber, Durkheim), Indian thinkers (Srinivas, Beteille, Ghurye), Caste in modern India, Agrarian change, Women's movement, Dalit assertion, Globalization impact on Indian society
mains.revision_strategy: Paper 1: Master 10 thinkers deeply. Paper 2: Use Indian examples extensively. Write 20-mark answers in 12-15 min. Use diagrams. Quote thinkers in every answer. Practice previous year papers.
